# Proven Supply Group

> Proven Supply Group (PSG) is a HUBZone-eligible national supplier of government
> facility products: plumbing, HVAC, MRO, janitorial/sanitation, fasteners/hardware,
> and industrial/electrical supply. PSG buys through 10 national distributor
> relationships, screens every line for TAA/BAA and Section 889 compliance, and
> returns firm, dated quotes to federal, state, and local buyers, usually within
> 24 hours. The principal answers the phone.

## Entity facts
- Legal name: Proven Supply Group LLC
- Location: 7270 Gilpin Way, Ste 150, Denver, CO 80229 (HUBZone-located office)
- Contact: Matt Gustafson, (970) 396-9855, matt@provensupplygroup.com
- SAM.gov: Active — UEI MY4VMF7G3A18, CAGE 1CQK4
- Primary NAICS: 423720 (Plumbing & Heating Equipment and Supplies). 26 NAICS registered.
- HUBZone: certification in process (NOT yet certified). Do not state as certified.
- Compliance: TAA/BAA screened; government purchase card (GPC) accepted.

## Capabilities
- Plumbing & Heating (Hydronics): pipe, fittings, valves, water heaters, boilers, hydronic equipment (NAICS 423720)
- HVAC & Refrigeration: warm-air heating, A/C and refrigeration equipment, filters, controls (NAICS 423730)
- Fasteners & Hardware: screws, bolts, nuts, washers, anchors, general hardware (NAICS 423710)
- Industrial, MRO & Electrical: electrical apparatus, lighting, motors, industrial equipment (NAICS 423840, 423610, 423440)
- Janitorial & Sanitation: floor-care equipment, cleaning chemicals and compounds (NAICS 423850, 424690)
- Paper & Facility Consumables: janitorial paper, facility consumables (NAICS 424130, 424990)

## How to buy
Send an RFQ, SF1449, part-number list, or a plain-language requirement by web form,
email, or phone. PSG prices it across its distributor network, screens for TAA/BAA
and Section 889, and returns a firm quote with a dated lead time, usually within 24
hours. Government purchase card accepted for micro-purchase and simplified-acquisition orders.
